entities.summary: Riley Jack Tufte is an American professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Providence Bruins of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Boston Bruins of the National Hockey League (NHL). He has played for the Fargo Force of the United States Hockey League (USHL), and played college ice hockey for the University of Minnesota-Duluth. Tufte was drafted in the first round, 25th overall, of the 2016 NHL entry draft by the Dallas Stars.
